gbm_population_evidence.quote: The pathology of the tumor is glioblastoma (IDH wild-type, WHO grade 4)

candidate_evidence.quote: Temozolomide will be administered continuously from the 1st to the 21st day after LITT surgery. The oral dose of temozolomide is 75 mg/m2.
This study aims to investigate the safety and efficacy of Laser Interstitial Thermal Therapy (LITT) combined with postoperative early use of temozolomide in treating recurrent glioblastomas.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The tumor was the first-time recurrence

role_evidence.quote: Temozolomide will be administered continuously from the 1st to the 21st day after LITT surgery. The oral dose of temozolomide is 75 mg/m2.

arms: LITT with Early Application of Temozolomide

coder_notes: Investigational question is early post-LITT temozolomide schedule in recurrent GBM; temozolomide is an established GBM therapy (D6), so not a candidate. LITT is a device/procedure, not an agent. IDH-wildtype used only to define GBM, not recorded as a biomarker row.
